∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] (dom : ι ↪ F) (d : ℕ), Minidregg.Selvage.constrainedRS dom d [] = ↑(Minidregg.Selvage.reedSolomonCode dom d)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] (f : ι → F) (γ : F) (cs : List (Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F)), Polynomial.eval γ (Minidregg.Selvage.defectPoly f cs) = Minidregg.Selvage.dotWt (Minidregg.Selvage.batchWt γ cs) f - Minidregg.Selvage.batchTarget γ cs

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] {f : ι → F} {cs : List (Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F)}, (∃ c ∈ cs, ¬Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c) → Minidregg.Selvage.defectPoly f cs ≠ 0
{ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → {F : Type u_2} → [Field F] → (ι → F) → (ι → F) → F
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] (a b f : ι → F), Minidregg.Selvage.dotWt (a + b) f = Minidregg.Selvage.dotWt a f + Minidregg.Selvage.dotWt b f
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] (γ : F) (a f : ι → F), Minidregg.Selvage.dotWt (γ • a) f = γ * Minidregg.Selvage.dotWt a f
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] (f : ι → F), Minidregg.Selvage.dotWt 0 f = 0
{ι : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq ι] → {F : Type u_2} → [Field F] → ι → F → Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] (φ : (ι → F) →ₗ[F] F), ∃ a, ∀ (f : ι → F), Minidregg.Selvage.dotWt a f = φ f

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] {dom : ι ↪ F} {d : ℕ} {cs : List (Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F)} {f : ι → F}, f ∈ Minidregg.Selvage.constrainedRS dom d cs ↔ f ∈ Minidregg.Selvage.reedSolomonCode dom d ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field F] {f : ι → F} {γ : F} {cs : List (Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F)}, Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f (Minidregg.Selvage.batchConstraint γ cs) ↔ Polynomial.eval γ (Minidregg.Selvage.defectPoly f cs) = 0
